sources.title: Do you need a visa?
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry publishes the live inbound country-by-country visa checker on its official mfa.gov.mk domain. It divides foreign nationalities by region and displays the North Macedonia entry-visa result for each selected nationality.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa for entering North Macedonia: REQUIRED

sources.title: Visa requirements for entering the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The North Macedonian MFA publishes current entry and visa conditions on its official mfa.gov.mk consular-services domain, including the 2026 temporary third-country-document decision.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of EU Member States and signatories of the Schengen Agreement DO NOT need a visa.

sources.title: Visa Application Procedure
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The North Macedonian MFA's official consular page describes how a foreigner obtains an entry visa through a diplomatic-consular representation.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The foreigner submits a visa application to the competent diplomatic-consular representation.

sources.title: Consolidated Law on Foreigners
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior of the Republic of North Macedonia / Official Gazette
sources.officialityEvidence: The Interior Ministry hosts the consolidated Official Gazette text of the Law on Foreigners on its official archival domain. Its visa provisions define a visa as an entry, short-stay or transit permit and require it before entry unless the law provides otherwise.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Странецот е должен да ја обезбеди визата пред неговото влегување.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions: Citizenship
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The North Macedonian MFA's official FAQ states the constitutional character of North Macedonian citizenship and explains that citizenship is a legal bond with the state.
sources.supportingExcerpt: ДРЖАВЈАНСТВО е правна врска меѓу Вас и државата.

policies.title: North Macedonian ordinary passport: citizenship
policies.summary: A North Macedonian national travelling on a North Macedonian ordinary passport is classified as citizenship rather than as a foreign visitor-visa relationship.
conditions: This is a citizenship classification only and does not define the foreign-visitor entry treatment of a dual national who presents another country's passport.
It does not establish residence, work, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, emergency-document or final border-admission treatment.

policies.title: EU and Schengen ordinary passports: visa-free entry
policies.summary: The MFA expressly exempts nationals of EU Member States and Schengen Agreement signatories from the North Macedonian entry-visa requirement.
conditions: The MFA additionally says these nationals may enter with a valid national identity card; this policy records the ordinary-passport relationship only.

The published short-stay framework is no more than 90 days in any 180-day period unless a law or ratified international agreement states otherwise. Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes are outside this policy.
A visa exemption does not remove document, purpose, funds, registration, public-order or final-admission checks.

policies.title: Other listed ordinary passports: visa-free entry
policies.summary: The MFA's live inbound country checker identifies these ordinary-passport issuers as not requiring a North Macedonian entry visa.
conditions: This is a visitor ordinary-passport baseline from the MFA checker. It does not turn a web enquiry, application form, or third-country visa into an eVisa, ETA or visa on arrival.

The published short-stay framework is no more than 90 days in any 180-day period unless a law or ratified international agreement states otherwise. The checker does not support flattening bilateral identity-card, biometric, SAR, diplomatic, official, service, crew, work, residence or special-document conditions.

For HK and MO, this records the listed SAR passport-code result only; it does not extend the waiver to Chinese, British, Portuguese or other travel documents. For XK, it records the MFA checker's Kosovo result without inferring recognition beyond that visitor entry treatment.

policies.title: Other foreign ordinary passports: advance visa required
policies.summary: The MFA's live country checker requires an entry visa for these ordinary passports, and the MFA procedure requires application through the competent diplomatic-consular representation before travel.
conditions: This is an advance-visa baseline, not eVisa availability: the MFA says applications are submitted in person to the competent resident or non-resident diplomatic-consular representation, from six months to at least 15 days before intended travel.

The published application requires a qualifying travel document, medical insurance, fee and evidence of purpose, accommodation, subsistence, onward or return travel and intention to leave. Visa issuance and admission remain discretionary.

A temporary decision from 1 January through 31 December 2026 waives a short-stay C visa for a third-country traveller holding a valid multiple-entry US, UK or Canadian visa inserted in the passport, valid at least five days beyond the intended stay; the allowed stay is up to 15 days. Valid EU/Schengen residence or a qualifying multiple-entry Schengen C visa can also create the separately stated 15-day route. These document-conditioned exceptions do not convert the named passport baseline into visa-free, eVisa, ETA or visa-on-arrival status.
Work, residence, airport transit, diplomatic, official, service, crew, UN travel documents and other special-document arrangements are not classified by this policy.

application.label: North Macedonia MFA advance-visa procedure
application.processingTime: The MFA requires submission no more than six months and at least 15 days before the intended trip; it does not publish a decision-time promise on this page.
steps: Apply in person to the competent resident or non-resident North Macedonian diplomatic-consular representation, except for the stated proxy exceptions.
Provide the travel document, photograph, medical insurance, fee evidence and documents proving the visit purpose, accommodation, means, transport and intention to leave.
Receive the visa decision before travel and present the visa and supporting travel documents for border control.
